description: Dashboard for reviewing DMARC reports stored in Loki via parsedmarc

options.content:
# DMARC Reports — Loki

This dashboard visualises DMARC aggregate, failure and SMTP TLS reports that
**parsedmarc** sends to Grafana Loki with the `[loki]` output.

Use the **Domain** dropdown above to filter aggregate reports by the domain the
report was published for.

The time picker selects by log line time. That is when parsedmarc saved a report,
unless the `[loki]` section sets `timestamp = report_begin`, which places reports at
the start of the reported period instead.

SMTP TLS failure details carry no policy domain, so that table lists the report ID.

targets.expr: sum by (spf_aligned) (sum_over_time({job="parsedmarc", report_type="aggregate", domain=~"$domain"} | json spf_aligned, count | __error__="" | unwrap count [$__range]))
sum by (dkim_aligned) (sum_over_time({job="parsedmarc", report_type="aggregate", domain=~"$domain"} | json dkim_aligned, count | __error__="" | unwrap count [$__range]))

sum by (disposition) (sum_over_time({job="parsedmarc", report_type="aggregate", domain=~"$domain"} | json disposition, count | label_format disposition=`{{ or .disposition "unknown" }}` | __error__="" | unwrap count [$__range]))

sum by (spf_results) (sum_over_time({job="parsedmarc", report_type="aggregate", domain=~"$domain"} | json spf_results, count | label_format spf_results=`{{ or .spf_results "none" }}` | __error__="" | unwrap count [1d]))

sum by (dkim_results) (sum_over_time({job="parsedmarc", report_type="aggregate", domain=~"$domain"} | json dkim_results, count | label_format dkim_results=`{{ or .dkim_results "none" }}` | __error__="" | unwrap count [1d]))
sum by (dmarc_aligned) (sum_over_time({job="parsedmarc", report_type="aggregate", domain=~"$domain"} | json dmarc_aligned, count | __error__="" | unwrap count [1d]))

sum by (disposition) (sum_over_time({job="parsedmarc", report_type="aggregate", domain=~"$domain"} | json disposition, count | label_format disposition=`{{ or .disposition "unknown" }}` | __error__="" | unwrap count [1d]))
sum (sum_over_time({job="parsedmarc", report_type="aggregate", domain=~"$domain"} | json count | __error__="" | unwrap count [$__range]))

sum by (source_base_domain) (sum_over_time({job="parsedmarc", report_type="aggregate", domain=~"$domain"} | json source_base_domain, count | label_format source_base_domain=`{{ or .source_base_domain "unknown" }}` | __error__="" | unwrap count [$__range]))

count by (org_name, org_extra_contact_info) (sum by (org_name, org_extra_contact_info, report_id) (count_over_time({job="parsedmarc", report_type="aggregate", domain=~"$domain"} | json org_name, org_extra_contact_info, report_id [$__range])))

panels.title: Message volume and DMARC compliance by from domain

targets.expr: label_replace(sum by (header_from) (sum_over_time({job="parsedmarc", report_type="aggregate", domain=~"$domain"} | json header_from, count | __error__="" | unwrap count [$__range])), "metric", "Messages", "", "")

label_replace(100 * sum by (header_from) (sum_over_time({job="parsedmarc", report_type="aggregate", domain=~"$domain"} | json header_from, dmarc_aligned, count | label_format passed=`{{ if eq .dmarc_aligned "true" }}{{ .count }}{{ else }}0{{ end }}` | __error__="" | unwrap passed [$__range])) / sum by (header_from) (sum_over_time({job="parsedmarc", report_type="aggregate", domain=~"$domain"} | json header_from, count | __error__="" | unwrap count [$__range])), "metric", "% DMARC Compliant", "", "")

sum by (source_country) (sum_over_time({job="parsedmarc", report_type="aggregate", domain=~"$domain"} | json source_country, count | label_format source_country=`{{ or .source_country "unknown" }}` | __error__="" | unwrap count [$__range]))

sum by (source_ip_address, source_reverse_dns, source_base_domain, source_country) (sum_over_time({job="parsedmarc", report_type="aggregate", domain=~"$domain"} | json source_ip_address, source_reverse_dns, source_base_domain, source_country, count | __error__="" | unwrap count [$__range]))
{job="parsedmarc", report_type="aggregate", domain=~"$domain"}

count by (domain, p, sp, adkim, aspf, pct, fo) (sum by (domain, p, sp, adkim, aspf, pct, fo, report_id) (count_over_time({job="parsedmarc", report_type="aggregate", domain=~"$domain"} | json domain, p, sp, adkim, aspf, pct, fo, report_id [$__range])))
{job="parsedmarc", report_type="aggregate", domain=~"$domain"}
{job="parsedmarc", report_type="aggregate", domain=~"$domain"}
{job="parsedmarc", report_type="failure"}
sum by (source_country) (count_over_time({job="parsedmarc", report_type="failure"} | json source_country [$__range]))

sum by (source_base_domain, source_country, source_ip_address, source_reverse_dns) (count_over_time({job="parsedmarc", report_type="failure"} | json source_base_domain, source_country, source_ip_address, source_reverse_dns [$__range]))
sum(sum_over_time({job="parsedmarc", report_type="smtp_tls"} | json policy_type, successful_session_count | policy_type!="" | __error__="" | unwrap successful_session_count [1d]))
sum(sum_over_time({job="parsedmarc", report_type="smtp_tls"} | json policy_type, failed_session_count | policy_type!="" | __error__="" | unwrap failed_session_count [1d]))

label_replace(sum(sum_over_time({job="parsedmarc", report_type="smtp_tls"} | json policy_type, successful_session_count | policy_type!="" | __error__="" | unwrap successful_session_count [$__range])), "result", "Successful", "", "")

label_replace(sum(sum_over_time({job="parsedmarc", report_type="smtp_tls"} | json policy_type, failed_session_count | policy_type!="" | __error__="" | unwrap failed_session_count [$__range])), "result", "Failed", "", "")
{job="parsedmarc", report_type="smtp_tls"} | json policy_type | policy_type!=""
{job="parsedmarc", report_type="smtp_tls"} | json result_type | result_type!=""
